# Included Studio assets

- `materials/grass/cards.webp`: Genvr grass cards cut from Poly Haven `grass_medium_01`, CC0.
  Source: https://polyhaven.com/a/grass_medium_01. Existing project generator: `tooling/realistic-models/grass-cards.py`.
- `materials/water/caustics.webp`: generated by Genvr `tooling/realistic-models/caustics.py`.

The legacy demo uses the two eager textures above. The Studio distribution additionally includes the same
tracked `brand`, `create`, `materials`, `models`, `human`, `bodies`, `audio`, `market` and `mediapipe` directories
as this website source revision, plus Three.js Draco/Basis decoders and the four film title fonts.

- Realistic models and ground textures: Poly Haven and ambientCG CC0; each library source URL and license is
  generated into `dist/studio-assets/licenses/library-sources.json` from the canonical Core Library.
- Procedural trees: EZ-Tree, MIT; bundled dependency notices are retained.
- Tidewater-derived models/materials/runtime: Dan Greenheck, MIT; `licenses/LICENSE-tidewater.md`.
- Human base/targets/rig data: MakeHuman community MPFB2 assets, CC0; `licenses/human-CREDITS.md`.
- Film fonts: unmodified Nunito, Merriweather, JetBrains Mono and Bebas Neue, SIL OFL1.1;
  `licenses/film-fonts/` includes all four full licenses and pinned source/hash provenance.
- Sea recordings and MediaPipe data retain their adjacent `audio/sea/CREDITS.md` and `mediapipe/NOTICE.txt`.
- Genvr-authored UI images, procedural models and code retain the repository AGPL-3.0-only license.

`dist/studio-assets.json` inventories every packaged asset by relative path, byte length and SHA256.
`licenses/dependencies.json` and `licenses/dependencies/` record the bundled UI/worker dependency notices.
No purchased marketplace packages, user uploads or optional speech model weights are included. The bundled
MediaPipe face-landmarker model is explicitly listed in its NOTICE. Optional speech,
translation, dubbing and map services retain the website's explicit network/model requirements; their external
data is not licensed or bundled by this archive. Account and publication services remain disabled locally.

## Wooden rowboat

`/models/realistic/rowboat/lod0.glb` is original Genvr procedural geometry (568 triangles, no external textures), rebuilt with `tooling/build-rowboat.mjs` in the SDK source package. It is covered by this project's AGPL-3.0-only license. The accompanying SVG is an original library icon. It is a decorative shore prop; no drivable boat or buoyancy capability is implied.

## Film language example

`/film-examples/island-languages.genvrfilm` contains a Genvr Standard robot recording in the procedural island and six generated demonstration dialogue outputs across three languages. It is a teaching sample, not an editable 3D scene file. Private voice profiles, reference recordings, optional model weights and imported character/motion libraries are excluded. Recorded face animation belongs to the original picture; alternate dubbing does not alter recorded lips.
